reasons: § 12.4 binds Customer with a 24-month post-term, all-product, any-territory non-compete with no carve-outs — squarely in the rule's walk-away band (post-term >12 months and undefined scope), so 'deviation' is correctly classified and the clause does not meet the fallback.

Deletion of p0050 is the minimal edit that reaches the preferred position (no restriction on Customer); § 12.3 already affirmatively preserves Customer's freedom, so nothing further is needed and no drafting gap is left behind.

Comment is accurate, concise, in the required voice with the [Playbook] prefix, cites the playbook position, notes the internal contradiction with § 12.3, and offers the narrowed fallback (single named product, term only, carve-outs) as instructed.
Deterministic checks confirm the operation applies and no open-ended compete restriction on Customer survives; no over-flagging of Vendor-side restrictions and no duplication with other rules.
